extracted.original_label: Local receipts - community services, rentals, lunch sales, student fees, participant contributions

issues.on_page: Five separately printed schedule lines: 1800 Revenue from community services activities 58,901 (p5), 1910 Other rental revenue 11,205 (p5), Lunch sales 560,320 (p11), Summer or night school fees 36,817 (p14), Participant contributions 156,972 (p15)
issues.issue: Five distinct printed lines with different categories are merged into one item and all 824,215 is categorized School Lunch Sales; 263,895 of it is not lunch sales. The breakdown is printed, so the split should be one item per line with its own category (Rentals 11,205, School Lunch Sales 560,320, charges/Tuition Received for the others). The arithmetic (sum 824,215) is correct.
User rule: rent/rental income is its own receipt category, Rentals (not charges for services/fees).

Community services revenue is not a student activity receipt. The category conflicts with its own detail_category (other charges for services), with the notes (which say charges for services/fees) and with receipts[6]. Charges for services/fees fits better.

issues.on_page: Student Fee Fund: Summer or night school fees 36,817
issues.issue: Summer school fees may be Tuition Received (the rule covers summer school tuition). This is a judgment call.
The statement (p3) counts this in 'Other disbursements', so the detail category Instruction differs from the statement line. The detail_category is not the exact list string 'supplies and materials'.

issues.on_page: Other disbursements 468,233 (Employee Benefit 282,892 + Cooperative 161,296 + Student Fee 24,045)
issues.issue: The printed label is 'Other', but the fund columns show what it holds: employee benefits paid, payments to cooperative service providers, and student fee supplies. It is left in other; review whether to recategorize.

issues.on_page: 2600 Operation and maintenance of plant: budget 6,352,310, actual 8,939,736
issues.issue: The final budget printed for this line is not recorded (left null because the actual was split into spending 5,882,379 and a 3,057,357 hidden transfer to the Depreciation Fund). The split itself checks: the statement p3 General Fund column 54,823,551 = schedule 53,672,115 - 3,057,357 + Depreciation 3,925,901 + Employee Benefit 282,892.
